'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Anthony Massung LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Massung]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).

Handwritten Xerox form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
